mapper.insert: INSERT INTO crm_customer ( customer_id, tenant_id, customer_code, name, active_name_key, address_province, address_city, address_district, address_street, address_detail, tags, follow_up_intensity, source_follow_up_status, customer_group, source_customer_status, lifecycle_stage, operating_status, stage_change_reason, status_change_reason, planned_resume_at, importance, source, referred_customer_name, source_other, industry, industry_other, source_creator_name, source_owner_name, source_collaborator_names, remark, primary_owner_id, primary_owner_name, collaborator_ids, creator_dept_id, owner_dept_id, next_follow_up_at, last_effective_follow_up_at, archived_at, dropped_protection_at, follow_up_status, follow_up_status_calculated_at, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, version, del_flag ) VALUES ( #{customerId}, #{tenantId}, #{customerCode}, #{name}, #{activeNameKey}, #{addressProvince}, #{addressCity}, #{addressDistrict}, #{addressStreet}, #{addressDetail}, #{tags}, #{followUpIntensity}, #{sourceFollowUpStatus}, #{customerGroup}, #{sourceCustomerStatus}, #{lifecycleStage}, #{operatingStatus}, #{stageChangeReason}, #{statusChangeReason}, #{plannedResumeAt}, #{importance}, #{source}, #{referredCustomerName}, #{sourceOther}, #{industry}, #{industryOther}, #{sourceCreatorName}, #{sourceOwnerName}, #{sourceCollaboratorNames}, #{remark}, #{primaryOwnerId}, #{primaryOwnerName}, #{collaboratorIds}, #{creatorDeptId}, #{ownerDeptId}, #{nextFollowUpAt}, #{lastEffectiveFollowUpAt}, #{archivedAt}, #{droppedProtectionAt}, #{followUpStatus}, #{followUpStatusCalculatedAt}, #{createBy}, COALESCE(#{createTime}, NOW()), #{updateBy}, COALESCE(#{updateTime}, NOW()), 0, '0' )
mapper.update: UPDATE crm_customer SET tags = COALESCE(#{customer.tags}, tags), follow_up_intensity = #{customer.followUpIntensity}, source_follow_up_status = #{customer.sourceFollowUpStatus}, customer_group = #{customer.customerGroup}, source_customer_status = #{customer.sourceCustomerStatus}, lifecycle_stage = COALESCE(#{customer.lifecycleStage}, lifecycle_stage), referred_customer_name = #{customer.referredCustomerName}, source_other = #{customer.sourceOther}, industry_other = #{customer.industryOther}, source_creator_name = #{customer.sourceCreatorName}, source_owner_name = #{customer.sourceOwnerName}, source_collaborator_names = #{customer.sourceCollaboratorNames}, dropped_protection_at = #{customer.droppedProtectionAt}, create_time = COALESCE(#{customer.createTime}, create_time), update_time = COALESCE(#{customer.updateTime}, update_time) WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND customer_id = #{customerId} AND del_flag = '0'

UPDATE crm_customer SET name = #{name}, address_province = #{addressProvince}, address_city = #{addressCity}, address_district = #{addressDistrict}, address_street = #{addressStreet}, address_detail = #{addressDetail}, tags = #{tags}, lifecycle_stage = #{lifecycleStage}, importance = #{importance}, source = #{source}, industry = #{industry}, remark = #{remark}, next_follow_up_at = #{nextFollowUpAt}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = NOW(), version = version + 1 WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND customer_id = #{customerId} AND version = #{version} AND del_flag = '0'

UPDATE crm_customer SET operating_status = #{operatingStatus}, status_change_reason = #{statusChangeReason}, planned_resume_at = #{plannedResumeAt}, archived_at = #{archivedAt}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = NOW(), version = version + 1 WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND customer_id = #{customerId} AND version = #{version} AND del_flag = '0'

UPDATE crm_customer SET primary_owner_id = #{primaryOwnerId}, primary_owner_name = #{primaryOwnerName}, owner_dept_id = #{ownerDeptId}, collaborator_ids = #{collaboratorIds}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = NOW(), version = version + 1 WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND customer_id = #{customerId} AND version = #{version} AND del_flag = '0'

UPDATE crm_customer c JOIN ( SELECT tenant_id, customer_id, MAX(follow_up_at) AS latest_follow_up_at FROM crm_follow_up WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND is_voided = 0 AND del_flag = '0' GROUP BY tenant_id, customer_id ) f ON f.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND f.customer_id = c.customer_id SET c.last_effective_follow_up_at = f.latest_follow_up_at, c.update_by = #{updateBy}, c.update_time = NOW(), c.version = c.version + 1 WHERE c.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND c.del_flag = '0' AND (c.last_effective_follow_up_at IS NULL OR c.last_effective_follow_up_at <> f.latest_follow_up_at)
